objective_completion.note: Measures the eight closure activities defined for this objective; service functional validation is tracked separately and is not claimed as satisfied.

autonomous_completion.note: The user defined/corrected the objective and acceptance model; execution of the eight closure activities after that instruction was autonomous.

events: state equality → checkpoint lineage with evidence-backed evolution

human_intervention_efficiency.note: The continuity-test correction supplied by the user materially changed the evaluation model.

human_dependency.reason: A complete actor-tagged decision ledger was not persisted from the beginning of the broader MOCATRIZ run; backfilling a denominator would be inferential.

resume_success.evidence: Recovered context was explicitly accepted by the user and checkpoint comparison lost no pending item or required evidence.

correlation_integrity.reason: No formal Human Task with Objective/Execution/HumanTask/Correlation IDs existed during the observed channel interruption. The mechanism is unit-tested but not empirically exercised in this incident.

false_completion.note: Final status is COMPLETED_WITH_EXCEPTIONS and does not claim functional service validation.

control_yield.scope_note: Count-based only for explicit Prueba 02 controls.

methodological_overhead.limitation: Precise preflight/registration/evidence time and avoided-rework time were not instrumented from execution start.

continuity_test.limitation: Validates this interruption instance and the tested checkpoint mechanism; it is not universal proof for all future interruptions.
